<?php /** @noinspection GrazieInspection */ ///** @noinspection ALL */
#{SIGNATURE_BLOCK}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace IGNORE;
#{PLUGIN_NAMESPACE};

use Illuminate\Support\Str;

use JsonException;
use RuntimeException;
use Timeax\FortiPlugin\Contracts\ConfigInterface;
use Timeax\FortiPlugin\Enums\PermissionType;
use Timeax\FortiPlugin\Enums\PluginSettingValueType;
use Timeax\FortiPlugin\Facades\Permissions;
use Timeax\FortiPlugin\Models\PluginSetting;
use Timeax\FortiPlugin\Permissions\Evaluation\Dto\PermissionListOptions;
use Timeax\FortiPlugin\Permissions\Evaluation\Dto\PermissionListResult;
use Timeax\FortiPlugin\Permissions\Evaluation\Dto\PermissionListSummary;
use Timeax\FortiPlugin\Permissions\Evaluation\Dto\Result;
use Timeax\FortiPlugin\Support\LoadedExportInfo;

final class Config implements ConfigInterface
{
    /** @var array<string, array<string,mixed>> */
    protected static array $manifest = [];
    /**
     * Cached plugin config values – loaded from plugin.config.json (or fallback).
     * @var array<string,mixed>
     */
    private static array $configData = [];

    /**
     * Runtime installation info (e.g., from DB / installer).
     * These placeholders are replaced during installation.
     * @var array{id:int|null,alias:string|null,name?:string|null}
     */
    private static array $info = [
        'id' => '#{PLUGIN_ID}',
        'alias' => '#{PLUGIN_ALIAS}',
        'name' => '#{PLUGIN_STUDLY}',
        'namespace' => '#{PLUGIN_NAMESPACE}',
        'basePath' => '#{PLUGIN_BASE_PATH}',
    ];


    /** Cached signature contents from `.internal/Signed`. */
    private static ?string $signature = null;

    /**
     * Resolve the configured public base template for this plugin.
     *
     * Returns a normalized path segment WITHOUT leading/trailing slashes.
     * Example: "vendor/fortiplugin/my-plugin"
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    protected static function resolvePublicBaseRelative(): string
    {
        $alias = self::getAlias();
        $slug = (string)(static::$info['slug'] ?? $alias);

        $baseTpl = (string)config('fortiplugin.ui.embed.public_base', '');
        if (trim($baseTpl) === '') {
            $baseTpl = '/vendor/fortiplugin/{alias}';
        }

        $base = strtr($baseTpl, [
            '{alias}' => $alias,
            '{slug}' => $slug,
            '{plugin}' => $alias, // backward-compat
        ]);

        return trim(str_replace('\\', '/', $base), '/');
    }

    /**
     * Get the Vite build manifest content.
     *
     * Supports separate builds:
     * - public/<public_base>/build/.vite/manifest.spa.json
     * - public/<public_base>/build/.vite/manifest.integrations.json
     *
     * @return array<string,mixed>
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    public static function getViteBuildManifest(string $lane = 'spa'): array
    {
        // Cache per lane (cache empty too)
        if (array_key_exists($lane, self::$manifest)) {
            return self::$manifest[$lane];
        }

        $file = match ($lane) {
            'spa', 'inertia' => 'manifest.spa.json',
            'embed', 'integrations' => 'manifest.integrations.json',
            default => 'manifest.json',
        };

        $relativeBase = static::resolvePublicBaseRelative();
        $path = public_path($relativeBase . '/build/.vite/' . $file);

        if (!is_file($path)) {
            return self::$manifest[$lane] = [];
        }

        $json = @file_get_contents($path);
        if ($json === false) {
            return self::$manifest[$lane] = [];
        }

        $decoded = json_decode($json, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

        return self::$manifest[$lane] = (is_array($decoded) ? $decoded : []);
    }

    /**
     * Returns a public URL for this plugin's published assets.
     * Example: "/vendor/fortiplugin/<alias>/build/integrations/x.y.z.js"
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    public static function getPublicUrl(string $path): string
    {
        $relativeBase = static::resolvePublicBaseRelative();

        $base = '/' . $relativeBase; // ensure leading slash
        $path = ltrim(str_replace('\\', '/', $path), '/');

        return rtrim($base, '/') . '/' . $path;
    }

    /**
     * Resolve embed/integration entry by Rollup input key (dot-name).
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    public static function getViteEmbededAsset(string $name): string
    {
        $manifest = self::getViteBuildManifest('integrations');

        foreach ($manifest as $entry) {
            if (!is_array($entry)) {
                continue;
            }

            // Keep it entry-only (recommended)
            if (($entry['isEntry'] ?? false) !== true) {
                continue;
            }

            // This matches your dot-name input keys: "pages.Admin.Dashboard", "__app_entry", etc.
            if (($entry['name'] ?? null) !== $name) {
                continue;
            }

            $file = $entry['file'] ?? null;

            if (is_string($file) && $file !== '') {
                // Manifest "file" is already like: "integrations/<name>.<hash>.js"
                return static::getPublicUrl('build/' . ltrim($file, '/'));
            }

            return '';
        }

        return '';
    }

    /**
     * Resolve an SPA override page asset by a friendly name like:
     * - "app" or "app.tsx"
     * - "Admin/Dashboard" or "Admin/Dashboard.tsx"
     *
     * It searches for manifest entry keys ending with:
     * - "/pages/<name>.(tsx|ts|jsx|js)"
     * - "/Pages/<name>.(tsx|ts|jsx|js)"
     *
     * @return string Public path like "/build/spa/<hash>.js" or "" if not found
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    public static function getVitePageAsset(string $name): string
    {
        $manifest = self::getViteBuildManifest();

        $name = str_replace('\\', '/', ltrim($name, '/\\'));

        // If the user supplied an extension, match only that;
        // otherwise try common script/tsx extensions.
        $exts = preg_match('/\.(tsx|ts|jsx|js)$/i', $name)
            ? [''] // keep as-is
            : ['.tsx', '.ts', '.jsx', '.js'];

        $targets = [];
        foreach ($exts as $ext) {
            $n = $ext === '' ? $name : ($name . $ext);

            // User may pass "pages/..." explicitly, but usually they pass "app" or "Admin/Dashboard"
            if (str_starts_with($n, 'pages/') || str_starts_with($n, 'Pages/')) {
                $targets[] = '/' . $n;
            } else {
                $targets[] = '/pages/' . $n;
                $targets[] = '/Pages/' . $n;
            }
        }

        $bestFile = null;
        $bestScore = null;

        foreach ($manifest as $key => $entry) {
            if (!is_string($key) || !is_array($entry)) {
                continue;
            }

            // Only consider actual entrypoints
            if (($entry['isEntry'] ?? false) !== true) {
                continue;
            }

            $file = $entry['file'] ?? null;
            if (!is_string($file) || $file === '') {
                continue;
            }

            $k = str_replace('\\', '/', $key);

            foreach ($targets as $suffix) {
                if (!str_ends_with($k, $suffix)) {
                    continue;
                }

                // Prefer "/pages/" over "/Pages/", then prefer shorter keys (more specific)
                $score = 0;
                if (str_contains($k, '/pages/')) $score += 100;
                if (str_contains($k, '/Pages/')) $score += 50;
                $score += max(0, 10000 - strlen($k));

                if ($bestScore === null || $score > $bestScore) {
                    $bestScore = $score;
                    $bestFile = $file;
                }
            }
        }

        return $bestFile ? static::getPublicUrl('/build/' . ltrim($bestFile, '/')) : '';
    }

    /* ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     |  Internal helpers (IO + tiny utilities)
     ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

    /**
     * Load and cache plugin.config.json (with safe fallbacks).
     *
     * Order tried:
     *  - plugin.config.json
     *  - config.json
     *  - plugin.json
     *
     * @return array<string,mixed>
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    private static function loadConfig(): array
    {
        if (self::$configData !== []) {
            return self::$configData;
        }

        $root = dirname(__DIR__); // Internal/.. → plugin root
        $candidates = [
            $root . '/plugin.config.json',
            $root . '/config.json',
            $root . '/fortiplugin.json',
        ];

        foreach ($candidates as $file) {
            if (is_file($file)) {
                $json = @file_get_contents($file);
                $arr = json_decode($json ?: 'null', true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
                if (is_array($arr)) {
                    return self::$configData = $arr;
                }
            }
        }

        return self::$configData = [];
    }

    /**
     * Dot-get helper over an array, with default.
     *
     * @template TDefault
     * @param array<string,mixed> $source
     * @param string $key
     * @param TDefault $default
     * @return mixed|TDefault
     */
    private static function arrayGet(array $source, string $key, mixed $default = null): mixed
    {
        if (array_key_exists($key, $source)) {
            return $source[$key];
        }
        $segments = explode('.', $key);
        $cursor = $source;
        foreach ($segments as $seg) {
            if (is_array($cursor) && array_key_exists($seg, $cursor)) {
                $cursor = $cursor[$seg];
            } else {
                return $default;
            }
        }
        return $cursor;
    }

    /**
     * Decode a PluginSetting row to native PHP according to its type enum.
     */
    private static function decodeHostSetting(?PluginSetting $row, mixed $default): mixed
    {
        if (!$row) {
            return $default;
        }

        $type = $row->type; // enum PluginSettingValueType
        $raw = $row->value;

        return match ($type) {
            PluginSettingValueType::string, PluginSettingValueType::file, PluginSettingValueType::blob => $raw,
            PluginSettingValueType::number => (Str::contains($raw, ['.', 'e', 'E']))
                ? (float)$raw
                : (int)$raw,
            PluginSettingValueType::boolean => filter_var($raw, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE) ?? $default,
            PluginSettingValueType::json => (static function () use ($raw, $default) {
                $decoded = json_decode($raw, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
                return json_last_error() === JSON_ERROR_NONE ? $decoded : $default;
            })(),
        };
    }

    /* ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     |  ConfigInterface – config & identity
     ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    public static function all(): array
    {
        return self::loadConfig();
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    public static function get(string $key, mixed $default = null): mixed
    {
        return self::arrayGet(self::all(), $key, $default);
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    public static function getName(): string
    {
        $fromInfo = (string)(self::$info['name'] ?? '');
        return $fromInfo !== '' ? $fromInfo : (string)self::get('name', '#{PLUGIN_STUDLY}');
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    public static function getAlias(): string
    {
        $alias = self::$info['alias'] ?? null;
        return is_string($alias) ? $alias : (string)self::get('alias', '#{PLUGIN_ALIAS}');
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    public static function getVersion(): string
    {
        return (string)self::get('version', '0.0.0');
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    public static function getDescription(): ?string
    {
        $d = self::get('description');
        return is_string($d) ? $d : null;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    public static function getAuthor(): ?string
    {
        $a = self::get('author');
        return is_string($a) ? $a : null;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    public static function getUiConfig(): ?array
    {
        $c = self::get('uiConfig');
        return is_array($c) ? $c : null;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    public static function getHostConfig(): ?array
    {
        $c = self::get('hostConfig');
        return is_array($c) ? $c : null;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    public static function getInfo(?string $key = null): string|array
    {
        // Ensure a consistent shape.
        $info = [
            'id' => is_numeric(self::$info['id'] ?? null) ? (int)self::$info['id'] : null,
            'alias' => is_string(self::$info['alias'] ?? null) ? (string)self::$info['alias'] : null,
            'name' => is_string(self::$info['name'] ?? null) ? (string)self::$info['name'] : self::getName(),
            'namespace' => is_string(self::$info['namespace'] ?? null) ? (string)self::$info['namespace'] : null,
            'basePath' => is_string(self::$info['basePath'] ?? null) ? (string)self::$info['basePath'] : null,
        ];

        if ($key !== null) return $info[$key] ?? '';
        //---
        return $info;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     */
    public static function getPluginId(): ?int
    {
        $id = self::$info['id'] ?? null;
        return is_numeric($id) ? (int)$id : null;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     */
    public static function getInstalledAlias(): ?string
    {
        $a = self::$info['alias'] ?? null;
        return is_string($a) ? $a : null;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     */
    public static function getSignature(): ?string
    {
        if (self::$signature !== null) {
            return self::$signature;
        }
        $p = dirname(__DIR__) . '/.internal/Signed';
        if (!is_file($p)) {
            return self::$signature = null;
        }
        return self::$signature = @file_get_contents($p) ?: null;
    }

    /* ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     |  Host settings (persisted)
     ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     */
    public static function getHost(string $key, mixed $default = null): mixed
    {
        $pluginId = self::getPluginId();
        if (!$pluginId) {
            return $default;
        }

        /** @var PluginSetting|null $row */
        $row = PluginSetting::query()
            ->where('plugin_id', $pluginId)
            ->where('key', $key)
            ->first();

        return self::decodeHostSetting($row, $default);
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     */
    public static function getAllHost(): array
    {
        $pluginId = self::getPluginId();
        if (!$pluginId) {
            return [];
        }

        $rows = PluginSetting::query()
            ->where('plugin_id', $pluginId)
            ->get();

        $out = [];
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $out[$row->key] = self::decodeHostSetting($row, null);
        }

        return $out;
    }

    /* -----------------------------------------------
        ␀|  Loaded export info
        ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    public static function load(?string $export = null): LoadedExportInfo
    {
        $all = self::all();

        // main ONLY when no parameter
        if ($export === null) {
            return self::resolveExportFile($all['main'] ?? null);
        }

        $export = trim($export);
        if ($export === '') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Export key cannot be empty.');
        }

        $exports = $all['exports'] ?? null;
        if (!is_array($exports)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Plugin config is missing "exports" map.');
        }

        // exports FULL STOP: exact key lookup (dots are allowed as literal key chars)
        $def = $exports[$export] ?? null;

        return self::resolveExportFile($def);
    }

    /** @var array<string, LoadedExportInfo|null> */
    private static array $exportResolveCache = [];

    /**
     * Strict resolver:
     * - resolves export definition to a CLASS FQCN only
     * - no reflection fallbacks
     * - If class does not exist after require_once, throws
     *
     * @param mixed $def string path OR ['file' => '...']
     * @throws RuntimeException|JsonException
     */
    private static function resolveExportFile(mixed $def): LoadedExportInfo
    {
        $file = null;

        if (is_string($def) && $def !== '') {
            $file = $def;
        } elseif (is_array($def) && isset($def['file']) && is_string($def['file']) && $def['file'] !== '') {
            $file = $def['file'];
        }

        if ($file === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Invalid export definition: missing file');
        }

        $absPath = self::resolveExportPath($file);
        $realPath = realpath($absPath) ?: $absPath;

        $cacheKey = static::class . '|' . $realPath;

        if (array_key_exists($cacheKey, self::$exportResolveCache)) {
            $cached = self::$exportResolveCache[$cacheKey];
            if ($cached === null) {
                throw new RuntimeException("Export file could not be resolved: $file");
            }
            return $cached;
        }

        if ($realPath === '' || !is_file($realPath)) {
            self::$exportResolveCache[$cacheKey] = null;
            throw new RuntimeException("Export file not found: $file");
        }

        [$ns, $class] = self::parseFirstDeclaredClass($realPath);

        if ($class === null || trim($class) === '') {
            self::$exportResolveCache[$cacheKey] = null;
            throw new RuntimeException("No class declaration found in export file: $file");
        }

        // If namespace missing in source, assume plugin root namespace
        $ns = trim((string)($ns ?? ''), '\\');
        if ($ns === '') {
            $ns = trim((string)self::getInfo('namespace'), '\\');
        }

        if ($ns === '') {
            self::$exportResolveCache[$cacheKey] = null;
            throw new RuntimeException("Cannot resolve class namespace for export: $file");
        }

        $fqcn = $ns . '\\' . $class;

        // If it's PSR-4 mapped, this should pass; otherwise we require_once for safety.
        if (!class_exists($fqcn)) {
            require_once $realPath;
        }

        if (!class_exists($fqcn)) {
            self::$exportResolveCache[$cacheKey] = null;
            throw new RuntimeException("Resolved class does not exist after loading file: $fqcn ($file)");
        }

        $info = new LoadedExportInfo(
            type: 'class',
            file: $file,
            realpath: $realPath,
            classString: $fqcn,
            className: $class,
            namespace: $ns,
            sha1: (string)@sha1_file($realPath),
            mtime: (int)(@filemtime($realPath) ?: 0),
            resolvedAt: date('c'),
        );

        return self::$exportResolveCache[$cacheKey] = $info;
    }

    /**
     * Parse the first declared class in a PHP file.
     * Returns [namespace|null, className|null].
     *
     * - Skips anonymous classes (`new class {}`).
     *
     * @return array{0:string|null,1:string|null}
     */
    private static function parseFirstDeclaredClass(string $realPath): array
    {
        $src = @file_get_contents($realPath);
        if ($src === false || $src === '') {
            return [null, null];
        }

        $tokens = token_get_all($src);

        $namespace = '';
        $className = null;

        $captureNamespace = false;
        $nsParts = [];

        $prevMeaningful = null;
        $captureClassName = false;

        foreach ($tokens as $tok) {
            if (!is_array($tok)) {
                continue;
            }

            [$id, $text] = $tok;

            if ($id === T_NAMESPACE) {
                $captureNamespace = true;
                $nsParts = [];
                continue;
            }

            if ($captureNamespace) {
                if (
                    $id === T_STRING ||
                    $id === T_NS_SEPARATOR ||
                    (defined('T_NAME_QUALIFIED') && $id === T_NAME_QUALIFIED)
                ) {
                    $nsParts[] = $text;
                    continue;
                }

                $namespace = trim(implode('', $nsParts));
                $captureNamespace = false;
                $nsParts = [];
            }

            if ($id === T_CLASS) {
                if ($prevMeaningful === T_NEW) {
                    $prevMeaningful = $id;
                    continue;
                }

                $captureClassName = true;
                $prevMeaningful = $id;
                continue;
            }

            if ($captureClassName) {
                if ($id === T_STRING) {
                    $className = $text;
                    break;
                }
                continue;
            }

            if ($id !== T_WHITESPACE && $id !== T_COMMENT && $id !== T_DOC_COMMENT) {
                $prevMeaningful = $id;
            }
        }

        return [$namespace !== '' ? $namespace : null, $className];
    }

    /**
     * @throws JsonException
     */
    private static function resolveExportPath(string $file): string
    {
        $file = trim($file);

        if ($file === '') {
            return '';
        }

        // Disallow stream wrappers (phar://, http://, etc.)
        if (preg_match('~^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.-]*://~', $file)) {
            return '';
        }

        // Block traversal in any path
        if (preg_match('~(^|/)\.\.(/|$)~', $file)) {
            return '';
        }

        // Absolute path is allowed (still traversal-checked above)
        if (self::isAbsolutePath($file)) {
            return $file;
        }

        // Resolve relative export file against the plugin install directory
        // and the current plugin folder (self::$info['name']).
        $pluginDir = trim((string)self::getInfo('name'));
        if ($pluginDir === '') {
            return '';
        }

        return plugin_path($pluginDir . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . ltrim($file, "/\\"));
    }

    private static function isAbsolutePath(string $path): bool
    {
        if (str_starts_with($path, '/') || str_starts_with($path, '\\')) {
            return true;
        }

        // Windows drive path: C:\... or C:/...
        return (bool)preg_match('~^[A-Za-z]:/.+~', $path);
    }



    /* ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     |  Permissions – list / has / get (via PermissionService)
     ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     */
    public
    static function getPermissions(?PermissionListOptions $options = null): PermissionListResult
    {
        $pluginId = self::getPluginId();
        if (!$pluginId) {
            return new PermissionListResult(
                items: [],
                summary: new PermissionListSummary(
                    byType: [],
                    total: 0,
                    active: 0,
                    inactive: 0,
                    requiredTotal: 0,
                    requiredSatisfied: 0,
                    requiredPending: 0
                )
            );
        }

        return Permissions::listPermissions($pluginId, $options ?? new PermissionListOptions());
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     */
    public
    static function hasPermission(
        PermissionType|string $type,
        string                $actionOrIntent,
        array|string|null     $meta = null,
        array                 $context = []
    ): bool
    {
        return self::checkPermission($type, $actionOrIntent, $meta, $context)->allowed;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     */
    public
    static function getPermission(
        PermissionType|string $type,
        array|string|null     $meta = null
    ): ?array
    {
        $pluginId = self::getPluginId();
        if (!$pluginId) {
            return null;
        }

        $t = $type instanceof PermissionType ? $type->value : (string)$type;
        $normalizedMeta = self::normalizeMeta($t, $meta);
        if ($normalizedMeta === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $list = self::getPermissions();
        foreach ($list->items as $item) {
            if ($item->type !== $t) {
                continue;
            }

            if (self::metaMatches($normalizedMeta, $item->concrete['meta'] ?? [])) {
                return $item->toArray();
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     */
    public
    static function checkPermission(
        PermissionType|string $type,
        string                $actionOrIntent,
        array|string|null     $meta = null,
        array                 $context = []
    ): Result
    {
        $t = $type instanceof PermissionType ? $type->value : (string)$type;
        $normalizedMeta = self::normalizeMeta($t, $meta);

        $pluginId = self::getPluginId();
        if (!$pluginId) {
            return Result::deny('plugin_not_installed', meta: $normalizedMeta);
        }

        if ($normalizedMeta === null) {
            return Result::deny('bad_target');
        }

        return self::dispatchCan($t, $pluginId, $actionOrIntent, $normalizedMeta, $context);
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     */
    public
    static function hasRequiredPermissions(): bool
    {
        return self::getPermissions()->summary->requiredPending === 0;
    }


    /**
     * Check if normalized meta matches the permission definition meta.
     */
    private
    static function metaMatches(array $requested, array $defined): bool
    {
        foreach ($requested as $key => $val) {
            if ($val === '' || $val === null || $val === []) {
                continue;
            }
            if (!isset($defined[$key]) || $defined[$key] !== $val) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Internal meta normalization layer.
     */
    private
    static function normalizeMeta(string $type, string|array|null $meta): ?array
    {
        if ($meta === null) {
            return null;
        }

        if (is_string($meta)) {
            return match ($type) {
                'db' => ['model' => $meta],
                'file' => ['path' => $meta],
                'module' => ['module' => $meta],
                'codec' => ['method' => $meta],
                'network' => [
                    'method' => 'GET',
                    'url' => $meta,
                    'host' => parse_url($meta, PHP_URL_HOST) ?? $meta
                ],
                'notification' => ['channel' => $meta],
                'route' => ['routeId' => $meta],
                default => null,
            };
        }

        if (is_array($meta)) {
            return match ($type) {
                'db' => [
                    'model' => (string)($meta['model'] ?? ($meta['table'] ?? '')),
                    'table' => (string)($meta['table'] ?? ''),
                    'columns' => is_array($meta['columns'] ?? null) ? array_values(array_unique(array_map('strval', $meta['columns']))) : [],
                ],
                'file' => [
                    'baseDir' => (string)($meta['baseDir'] ?? ''),
                    'path' => (string)($meta['path'] ?? ''),
                ],
                'notification' => [
                    'channel' => (string)($meta['channel'] ?? ''),
                    'template' => (string)($meta['template'] ?? ''),
                    'recipient' => (string)($meta['recipient'] ?? ''),
                ],
                'module' => [
                    'module' => (string)($meta['module'] ?? ''),
                    'api' => (string)($meta['api'] ?? ''),
                ],
                'network' => [
                    'method' => strtoupper((string)($meta['method'] ?? 'GET')),
                    'url' => (string)($meta['url'] ?? ''),
                    'host' => (string)($meta['host'] ?? ''),
                    'headers' => $meta['headers'] ?? null,
                ],
                'codec' => [
                    'method' => (string)($meta['method'] ?? ''),
                    'options' => $meta['options'] ?? [],
                ],
                'route' => [
                    'routeId' => (string)($meta['routeId'] ?? ''),
                    'guard' => (string)($meta['guard'] ?? ''),
                ],
                default => $meta,
            };
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Dispatch to the correct typed `can*` method on the Permissions facade.
     */
    private
    static function dispatchCan(string $type, int $pluginId, string $action, array $target, array $context): Result
    {
        return match ($type) {
            'db' => Permissions::canDb($pluginId, $action, $target, $context),
            'file' => Permissions::canFile($pluginId, $action, $target, $context),
            'notification' => Permissions::canNotify($pluginId, $action, $target, $context),
            'module' => Permissions::canModule($pluginId, $target, $context),
            'network' => Permissions::canNetwork($pluginId, $target, $context),
            'codec' => Permissions::canCodec($pluginId, $target, $context),
            'route' => Permissions::canRouteWrite($pluginId, $target, $context),
            default => Result::deny('unknown_type'),
        };
    }
}

namespace Plugins\#{PLUGIN_STUDLY}\Internal;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\File;

return final class Config
{
    /** Cached copy for the current request */
    private static array $data;

    /** Load JSON once (dev env) */
    private static function load(): array
    {
        if (isset(self::$data)) {
            return self::$data;

<?php
/**
 * FortiPlugin routes autoloader.
 * Scans the configured output root and requires each plugin's routes/{slug}/index.php.
 */

$root = (string) config('fortiplugin.routes.output_root', base_path('routes'));
$root = rtrim($root, DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR);

// If the root is something like base_path('routes'), plugins live under routes/{slug}
// We only scan **directories** and look for index.php inside them.
if (!is_dir($root)) {
    return;
}

$it = new DirectoryIterator($root);
foreach ($it as $entry) {
    if ($entry->isDot() || !$entry->isDir()) {
        continue;
    }
    $index = $entry->getPathname() . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR . 'index.php';
    if (is_file($index)) {
        require $index;
    }
}

export type PluginUploadStreamEvent =
  | PluginScanConfigOkEvent
  | PluginScanConfigFailedEvent
  | PluginScanBeginEvent
  | PluginScanOkEvent
  | PluginScanFailedEvent
  | PluginScanPendingEvent
  | PluginScanCompleteEvent
  | PluginScanConfigFailedEvent
  | PluginScanErrorEvent;

export interface PluginScanConfigOkEvent {
  stage: 'config-ok';
  message: string;
}

export interface PluginScanConfigFailedEvent {
  stage: 'config-failed';
  status: 'failed';
  errors: any;
}

export interface PluginScanConfigFailedEvent {
  stage: 'db-entry';
  status: 'failed';
  errors: string;
}
//-----------

export interface PluginScanBeginEvent {
  stage: 'begin-scan';
  total: number;
  plugin_zip_id: number;
}

export interface PluginScanOkEvent {
  stage: 'ok';
  file: string;
  progress: [number, number]; // [validated, totalFiles]
}

export interface PluginScanFailedEvent {
  stage: 'failed';
  file: string;
  violations: any[]; // You may want to define a Violation interface
  progress: [number, number];
}

export interface PluginScanPendingEvent {
  stage: 'pending';
  file: string;
  size: number;
}

export interface PluginScanCompleteEvent {
  stage: 'complete';
  status: 'valid' | 'failed' | 'pending';
  failed_files: Array<{ file: string; violations: any[] }>;
  pending_files: string[];
  plugin_zip_id: number;
}

export interface PluginScanErrorEvent {
  status: 'failed';
  errors: any; // array or object, depending on your error reporting
}

// Optionally, a more specific violation interface:
export interface Violation {
  type: string;
  line?: number;
  token?: string;
  snippet?: string;
  issue?: string;
  // add more as needed
}

// noinspection NpmUsedModulesInstalled,JSUnresolvedReference,JSUnusedGlobalSymbols

import {defineConfig} from "vite";
import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
import tailwindcss from "@tailwindcss/vite";
import fortiPrep, {discoverEntrypoints} from "fortiplugin-bundle-adapter"; // ← your new adapter package name
import {resolve} from "node:path";

const integrations = discoverEntrypoints("resources/embed/ts");

export default defineConfig({
    appType: "custom",
    publicDir: false,

    // Order matters: run the adapter after React/Tailwind so it rewrites final entry chunks
    plugins: [
        tailwindcss(),
        react(),
        fortiPrep({
            injectedIds: ["react", "react/jsx-runtime"],
            injectedPrefixes: ["@inertiajs/", "@host/"],
            runtimeKey: "imports",
            depsParam: "deps",
        }),
    ],

    build: {
        outDir: "public/build",
        emptyOutDir: false, // do NOT wipe the SPA build
        manifest: ".vite/manifest.integrations.json", // path is relative to outDir
        rollupOptions: {
            // Keep these externals (the adapter ALSO sets external, but this keeps intent explicit here)
            external: (id) =>
                id === "react" ||
                id === "react/jsx-runtime" ||
                id.startsWith("@inertiajs/") ||
                id.startsWith("@host/"),

            input: {
                ...integrations,
            },

            output: {
                format: "es",
                entryFileNames: "integrations/[name].[hash].js",
                chunkFileNames: "embed-chunks/[name].[hash].js",
                assetFileNames: "embed-assets/[name].[hash][extname]",
            },
        },
    },

    resolve: {
        alias: {
            "@/main": resolve("resources/inertia"),
            "@/embed": resolve("resources/embed"),
            "@/shared": resolve("resources/shared"),
        },
    },
});

import {defineConfig} from 'vite';
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react';
import tailwindcss from '@tailwindcss/vite';
import {resolve} from 'node:path';

const inertiaEntry = 'resources/inertia/ts/app.tsx';

export default defineConfig({
    appType: 'custom',
    publicDir: false,

    plugins: [tailwindcss(), react()],

    build: {
        outDir: 'public/build',
        emptyOutDir: true, // SPA build runs first and clears
        manifest: '.vite/manifest.spa.json', // string path is relative to outDir 0
        rollupOptions: {
            input: {
                inertia: resolve(inertiaEntry),
            },
            output: {
                format: 'es',
                entryFileNames: 'spa/[name].[hash].js',
                chunkFileNames: 'spa-chunks/[name].[hash].js',
                assetFileNames: 'spa-assets/[name].[hash][extname]',
            },
        },
    },

    resolve: {
        alias: {
            '@/main': resolve('resources/inertia'),
            '@/embed': resolve('resources/embed'),
            '@/shared': resolve('resources/shared'),
        },
    },
});
